title: Lebo and Gogo’s Tea Party (SASL)
description: Lebo is excited to have a day of adventure with Gogo. When Gogo hurts herself, she can’t do anything that Lebo wants to do. What can Gogo and Lebo do to have fun together?

usagePolicy.reason: The complete illustrated edition and editable source files remain at Book Dash; this local entry preserves discovery and creator attribution.
